Video footage showed demonstrators in balaclavas chanting "stop the boats," in a reference to refugees and migrants who attempt the dangerous English channel crossing in a bid to reach Great Britain. This came despite the fact that crossing dropped 40% between January and August 2026 compared to the previous year. stories.title: Germany: Is Saxony-Anhalt's economy really struggling?
stories.summary: Germany's far-right AfD party has long claimed that the eastern state of Saxony-Anhalt has been left behind. Is that really the case? A closer look at the data offers some interesting insights.

stories.title: Serbia: How the funeral of Ratko Mladic is dividing a nation
stories.summary: As the Serbian government leaves the decision about Ratko Mladic's funeral arrangements to his family, international pressure on the country is mounting. How do Serbs feel about the matter?

stories.title: The hidden environmental cost of AI data centers
stories.summary: As data centers multiply to meet AI demand, they're straining power grids, draining water supplies and reshaping the land and air around them.

On Tuesday, Federal Interior Minister Alexander Dobrindt told reporters that the methods used in the attempted attack were consistent with those seen in other Russian hybrid operations, citing the drone's construction, various components, explosives and detonation technology. stories.title: Iranian café chain mogul jailed and stripped of assets for backing January protests
stories.summary: Sadegh Saeedinia, manager of the Saeedinia café chain, was convicted of "propaganda against national security" for posting about the January protests on Instagram and encouraging staff to strike, in one of the harshest sentences handed to a private entrepreneur since the unrest.

stories.title: Russians skewer authorities for ordering citizens to register their chicken
stories.summary: A government decree requiring registration of domestic birds, camels and reindeer took effect Tuesday, sending Russians to government service centres with live chickens in tow before authorities clarified that owners did not need to bring their animals anywhere.

stories.title: Trump hints US may not back UK over Falkland Islands, citing lack of Iran support
stories.summary: The US recognises Britain's administration of the Falkland Islands but remains neutral over the competing sovereignty claims.

stories.summary: About 900 workers are missing from 12 hydropower projects in Nepal, with roughly 500 believed to be trapped in tunnels, according to local authorities.

stories.title: Malaysia declares air quality emergency as haze linked to Indonesia fires reaches critical level
stories.summary: Haze is a recurring seasonal problem in Southeast Asia, where smoke from forest and peat fires in Indonesia can travel across national borders and affect neighbouring Malaysia, Brunei and Singapore.

stories.title: Nepal rescuers try to reach dozens trapped in tunnel after two found alive
stories.summary: More than 1,300 people have died and thousands are missing, but rescuers' hopes have risen after finding survivors in a tunnel.
